description: Machine-readable knowledge catalog with explicit evidence states and controlled evolution.

entries.title: AI as a Data Holder
entries.summary: AI can organize and retrieve structured knowledge.

entries.title: AI as Static/Living/Mythic Book
entries.summary: A three-mode metaphor for stable, evolving, and imaginative knowledge.

entries.title: AI as Conceptual Database
entries.summary: A queryable conceptual store with relationships and metadata.

entries.title: R-Node
entries.summary: A conceptual node in the R-Web.

entries.title: R-Web
entries.summary: A network of related R-Nodes.

entries.title: Static Layer
entries.summary: Stable concepts and preserved reference material.

entries.title: Morph Layer
entries.summary: Controlled transformation of concepts over time.

entries.title: Myth Layer
entries.summary: Creative and speculative representations, explicitly distinguished from verified facts.

entries.title: R-Speak
entries.summary: A proposed vocabulary or interface for library operations.

entries.title: R-Flux
entries.summary: A proposed representation of change and flow across concepts.

entries.title: User Defines Importance
entries.summary: User priorities influence ranking and attention.

entries.title: Chat Isolation
entries.summary: Keep conversation context boundaries explicit; do not imply cross-chat persistence without a real store.

entries.title: Library Auto-Organizes
entries.summary: Automatically propose normalized shelf and index placement.

entries.title: Controlled Evolution
entries.summary: Record changes, preserve history, and validate before promotion.

entries.title: Alien Datastore
entries.summary: Creative metaphor for an unfamiliar knowledge architecture.

entries.title: Living Book
entries.summary: Creative metaphor for evolving, linked knowledge.

entries.title: Mythic Layer Behavior
entries.summary: Rules for fictional or symbolic descriptions within the myth layer.

entries.title: Querying the Library
entries.summary: Find entries by ID, title, shelf, and relationships.

entries.title: Adding Entries
entries.summary: Add entries only with validated IDs, evidence class, and initial history.

entries.title: Updating Concepts
entries.summary: Version concept edits with a reason and preserved prior record.

entries.title: Mutating Systems
entries.summary: Apply controlled, reviewable changes to the library structure.

entries.title: Auto-Curator Mode
entries.summary: Proposed classifier and normalization workflow; not an always-running service.

entries.title: Heartbeat Monitor
entries.summary: Status report contract for validation and operational checks.

entries.title: Library Integrity Checker
entries.summary: Validate IDs, references, history, evidence labels, and declared conflicts.

entries.title: Expansion Engine
entries.summary: Propose additions after the current manifest passes validation.

entries.title: Concept DNA
entries.summary: Stable identity and canonical metadata for each concept.

entries.title: Relationship Graph
entries.summary: Explicit edges between entries with referential integrity checks.

entries.title: Evidence Lineage
entries.summary: Distinguish idea, hypothesis, implemented, tested, and verified states.

history.reason: Prevent proposed work being represented as verified

entries.title: Evolution Ledger
entries.summary: Monotonic per-entry version history with change and reason.

entries.title: Contradiction Resolver
entries.summary: Flag explicitly declared contradictions and normalized-title collisions for human review; do not auto-resolve them.

history.reason: Surface conflicts without silently changing meaning

entries.title: Knowledge Compression
entries.summary: Summarize entries without removing the canonical source or its history.

history.reason: Support concise retrieval while preserving provenance
